notes: Dish cards for Snap a dish: the usual home or hawker version of popular Singapore and Asian dishes, listing each part with its weight and role (meat, seafood, egg and the five pungent included as they are usually cooked) so the app can swap animal parts for plant ones. Parts and serving weights are drafted by QuinTaste from common recipes and hawker portions and wait for staff and cook review. Protein and energy per serving appear only where a measured dish record of the same dish exists (USDA FNDDS, UK CoFID, Taiwan FDA or the Japanese Standard Tables); they are the record's per-100 g figures scaled to the serving, and are left out when no honest record exists.
